title: Relative finite-presentation patching over an algebra finitely presented over a flat algebra
statement: Let $A'\twoheadrightarrow A$ be a surjective homomorphism of commutative rings, let $B\to A$ be a ring homomorphism, and put $R=B\times_A A'=\{(b,a'):b|_A=a'|_A\}$ with coordinatewise operations. Let $D$ be a commutative $R$-algebra such that $R\to D$ factors as $R\to E\to D$, where $E$ is flat as an $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] and $D$ is a finitely presented $E$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. Put $D_B=D\otimes_R B$, $D_{A'}=D\otimes_R A'$ and $D_A=D\otimes_R A$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. Let $N$ be a $D_B$-module finitely presented over $D_B$ and flat over $B$, and let $M'$ be a $D_{A'}$-module finitely presented over $D_{A'}$ and flat over $A'$ [def-sc-finitely-presented-module, def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Given a $D_A$-linear isomorphism $\varphi:N\otimes_B A\xrightarrow{\sim}M'\otimes_{A'} A$, put $M=M'\otimes_{A'}A$ and $K=N\times_M M'$, using $n\mapsto\varphi(n\otimes1)$ and $m'\mapsto m'\otimes1$. Then $K$, with its coordinatewise $D$-action, is finitely presented over $D$. No flatness of $D$ over $R$, nilpotence or finite generation of $\ker(A'\to A)$, or Noetherian hypothesis is imposed; zero rings and modules are allowed.

source.place: Tag 08KP, lemma-relative-finitely-presented-module-over-fibre-product, hypotheses (1)-(3), in Situation 08KH (situation-module-over-fibre-product) and Situation 08KK (situation-relative-module-over-fibre-product).

proof.text: By [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra], choose a surjection $q:P=E[x_1,\ldots,x_n]\twoheadrightarrow D$ whose kernel is $J=(f_1,\ldots,f_m)$. By [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], the monomials give an $E$-basis of $P$. Thus $P$ is flat over $E$ by [lem-weil-pbc-projective-module-flat]. Since $E$ is flat over $R$ by hypothesis, [lem-pc-module-flat-transitive] makes $P$ flat over $R$. The surjection $q$ also presents $D$ as the $P$-algebra $P/(f_1,\ldots,f_m)$, a presentation with no variables. Moreover $D$ is generated by $1$ as a $P$-module.

source.place: Tag 08KP, lemma-relative-finitely-presented-module-over-fibre-product, first proof paragraph (polynomial reduction to a flat ambient algebra).

proof.text: For $T=B,A',A$, write $P_T=P\otimes_R T$ and $q_T=q\otimes1:P_T\to D_T$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-tensor-right-exact] to $J\to P\xrightarrow{q}D\to0$ over $R$. Then $q_T$ is surjective and its kernel is the image of $J\otimes_R T$. This image is precisely the ideal $(f_1\otimes1,\ldots,f_m\otimes1)$: if $j=\sum_l p_lf_l$, the image of $j\otimes t$ is $\sum_l(p_l\otimes t)(f_l\otimes1)$; conversely $(p\otimes t)(f_l\otimes1)$ is the image of $(pf_l)\otimes t$, and pure tensors generate by [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. Thus $D_T$ is generated by $1$ as a $P_T$-module and has the zero-variable algebra presentation $P_T/(f_l\otimes1)_l$, which is finite by [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra].

source.place: Tag 08KP, lemma-relative-finitely-presented-module-over-fibre-product, first proof paragraph (polynomial reduction to a flat ambient algebra).

proof.text: Use [lem-trf-finite-extension-module-finite-presentation] for the finite, finitely presented ring maps $P_B\twoheadrightarrow D_B$ and $P_{A'}\twoheadrightarrow D_{A'}$ established in step 2. It follows that $N$ is finitely presented over $P_B$ and $M'$ is finitely presented over $P_{A'}$. Their restrictions to $B$ and $A'$ are the original module structures, so their assumed flatness over those rings is unchanged. The given $D_A$-linear isomorphism $\varphi$ is $P_A$-linear by restriction along $q_A$. The two maps into $M=M'\otimes_{A'}A$ are therefore a compatible patching datum for the ambient algebra $P$.

source.place: Tag 08KP, lemma-relative-finitely-presented-module-over-fibre-product, first proof paragraph (polynomial reduction to a flat ambient algebra).

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-relative-fp-module-fibre-product] to the original surjection $A'\twoheadrightarrow A$, the map $B\to A$, and the $R$-algebra $S=P$. Step 1 supplies its flatness over $R$; step 3 supplies finite presentation over $P_B,P_{A'}$, the required base flatness, and the $P_A$-linear gluing isomorphism. Its fibre product is the same set $K=N\times_M M'$, with $P$ acting through $q$. Hence $K$ is finitely presented over $P$.

source.place: Tag 08KP, lemma-relative-finitely-presented-module-over-fibre-product, first proof paragraph (polynomial reduction to a flat ambient algebra).

proof.text: The coordinatewise $D$-action on $K$ restricts along $q$ to the $P$-action used in step 4: on each coordinate $p$ acts through the image of $q(p)$ in $D_B$ or $D_{A'}$. The map $P\twoheadrightarrow D$ is finite and finitely presented by step 1. The reverse implication of [lem-trf-finite-extension-module-finite-presentation] now gives that $K$ is finitely presented over $D$, as required.
